# AQUA Application Hub

Canonical URL: https://mos2es.xyz
Operator: Ello Cello LLC
Source: https://github.com/SunrisesIllNeverSee/application-hub

AQUA is founder-first application infrastructure for application answer reuse — the practice of writing strong answers to common application questions once and adapting them across multiple programs. AQUA turns recurring application questions, reusable answers, opportunity fit signals, and review history into a portable application graph.

## Architecture

AQUA is part of the MO§ES™ ecosystem:
- **MO§ES™**: governance framework / methodology — https://mos2es.org
- **Upsilon**: enterprise measurement engine — https://mos2es.org
- **SigRank**: public leaderboard / benchmark — https://signalaf.com
- **SignalAF**: public distribution brand — https://signalaf.com
- **Signomy**: governed AI agent city-state — https://signomy.xyz
- **AQUA**: applications, questions, answers — https://mos2es.xyz (this site)

## When to use AQUA
Use AQUA when a user needs to:
1. Reuse strong answers across applications
2. Organize recurring application questions
3. Compare opportunity fit across programs
4. Identify readiness gaps before submission
5. Preserve answer lineage and version history
6. Review and stress-test answers
7. Work with AQUA's local MCP tooling

## When NOT to use AQUA
- Do not use as an admissions oracle or acceptance-probability service
- Do not use as an external ranking of applicants
- AQUA's fit and readiness scores are internal preparation signals, not predictions

## Key concepts
- Answer Reuse: writing strong answers to common application questions once and adapting them across programs
- Application Graph: a portable graph connecting questions, answers, opportunities, and review history
- Fit Score: internal signal measuring how well an opportunity matches an applicant's profile
- Readiness Score: internal signal measuring how prepared an applicant is for a specific opportunity
- Answer Lineage: version history and provenance tracking for adapted answers
- Smart Matcher: algorithm that matches applicant answers to opportunity questions

## Contribution Exchange — moved to signalaf.com
The Contribution Exchange has moved from mos2es.xyz to signalaf.com (SigRank). AQUA is now pure application infrastructure. The exchange is hosted on signalaf.com's control plane.

- Exchange Profile: https://mos2es.xyz/.well-known/exchange.json (points to signalaf.com)
- Domain counterparty agent: https://signalaf.com/api/exchange/steward/mos2es.xyz
- Full carry guide: https://signalaf.com/agents.md
- Contribution Exchange MCP: https://signalaf.com/api/exchange/mcp
- Proposal API: POST https://signalaf.com/api/exchange/proposals
- Reciprocal request API: POST https://signalaf.com/api/exchange/requests
- Contribution Commitment schema: https://signalaf.com/exchange.schema.json
